requirements.title: 10 products / 30 operating units and canonical history
requirements.reason: Competition PR #20 already restored the ERA operating-unit inventory and canonical multi-dataVersion trend authority.
runtimeChecks: 10 distinct global products
30 store-product operating units per report period
same product in different stores never shares history
canonical snapshots remain visible across dataVersions

requirements.title: Fresh upload identity: sourceContentHash is not dataVersion
runtimeChecks: same report bytes may keep the same source content hash
every accepted upload receives a fresh dataVersion
fresh upload cannot replay an old run solely by source hash

requirements.title: Agent1 exact execution identity
runtimeChecks: itemExecutionId is required for every Agent1 item
inputContentHash must match the exact projected input
productId/storeId/signalId may not be used as fallback join keys

requirements.title: Agent1 partial failure isolation
runtimeChecks: one missing or contract-invalid item does not invalidate sibling operating units
P10007 store variants are accepted or rejected independently
contract-invalid returned output is not retried as a missing product

requirements.title: Competition Agent1 stays deterministic single-worker
runtimeChecks: provider batches execute sequentially
no ThreadPool/fan-out concurrency is introduced by recovery
downstream Agent2/Agent3 only run after Agent1 aggregation

requirements.title: Agent stage artifact/hash lineage and real gates
runtimeChecks: Agent input/output artifacts retain parent lineage
frontend status reads persisted runtime state rather than inferring completion from task counts
partial Agent1 completion remains auditable

requirements.title: report_received idle / worker handoff
runtimeChecks: measure upload accepted -> first deterministic processing timestamp
no fixed ~402 second idle before processing
trace the existing competition worker/tick chain before changing implementation

requirements.title: Mother-repo OPC deployment implementation
requirements.reason: Competition repository already owns Registry Lineage, Runtime Package, ECS Candidate Smoke, Three Report E2E and Release Hash Seal. Only deployment intent may be compared; implementation is not copied.
